card.name: Rounding and repeating dose instructions
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'to', 'the', 'as' and 'next' inside instructions about rounding vial counts or volumes up or down. Also words in repeat or missed-dose directions.

modes.label: Rounding vials or volumes
modes.description: Linking word right after 'round up' or 'rounding' before 'the next whole number' or 'nearest 0.1 mL'.
modes.example: Round the number of vials up<< to>> the next whole number.

modes.label: Repeat or missed doses
modes.description: Word in a sentence about doubling, repeating, or giving a dose again as necessary.
modes.example: there is no need to double<< the>> dose at the next scheduled time.

card.plain: It marks the little words in instructions on how to round a calculated dose or repeat a dose.
